reason: Aggregates public GitHub and npm ecosystem data into sortable Top 10 or Top 100 plugin rankings, with scheduled refreshes, local snapshots, and a DSH Web settings interface.

summaries.zh: 从 GitHub、npm 及公开目录汇总插件数据，按热度或下载量展示可排序的 Top 10/Top 100 榜单。
summaries.en: Aggregates public GitHub, npm, and directory data to display sortable Top 10 or Top 100 plugin rankings by popularity or downloads.

capabilities: Reads public GitHub, npm, and directory data through unauthenticated APIs or CDN resources
Aggregates and ranks plugin metadata by GitHub stars or npm weekly downloads
Stores ranking snapshots and settings locally
Runs scheduled or manually triggered refreshes
Displays rankings and source links in a DSH Web settings panel
